context.body: Private preparation becomes a public charge before Israel’s leaders.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: David names Solomon as the chosen builder and calls him to know God, serve wholeheartedly, and seek God.
observations.label: David presents Solomon before Israel: action

observations.body: The gathered leaders hear that royal and Temple succession are bound together.
observations.label: David presents Solomon before Israel: response

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 28:1–10 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Solomon is described as chosen while the warning still leaves refusal possible.
payload.title: David presents Solomon before Israel
